description: Generate multiple ecommerce scene variants from a product image, optional segmentation, and prompt guidance.

fields.name: imageUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the product image. The image must be up to 20 MB and between 385 and 8192 pixels in both width and height.

fields.name: strength
fields.description: Variation strength from 0.1 to 1. Defaults to 0.5.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: Scene generation prompt, up to 600 characters.

fields.name: imageOutputWidth
fields.description: Desired output width in pixels, from 32 to 2048.

fields.name: imageOutputHeight
fields.description: Desired output height in pixels, from 32 to 2048.

fields.name: outputNum
fields.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4.
